narrative.intro: Undersea Sensor Systems obligated $245M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date, across 18 awards with an average award size of $13.6M. Obligations fell 37.9% year over year, down from a FY25 total of $394M. Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing is the dominant market, accounting for $241M in FY2026 to date. Smaller markets in FY2026 to date include Other Aircraft Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing at $2.1M and Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing at $1.4M. Historical obligations show variation: FY21 was $7.7M, FY22 was $12.1M, FY23 was $2.7M, FY24 was $1.8M, FY25 was $394M, and FY26 is $245M. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date obligations. The data lists award counts and market NAICS totals but does not name purchasing agencies or list expiring contract line items in the FY2026 to date figures.
